∀ {F : Type u} [inst : Field F] {Idx : Type u} (asg : Idx → F) (c : F), Minidregg.Compiler.eval asg (Minidregg.Compiler.cst c) = c

∀ {F : Type u} [inst : Field F] {Idx : Type u} (asg : Idx → F) (a b : Minidregg.Compiler.Term (Minidregg.Compiler.AirSig F Idx)), Minidregg.Compiler.eval asg (Minidregg.Compiler.mul' a b) = Minidregg.Compiler.eval asg a * Minidregg.Compiler.eval asg b
∀ {F : Type u} [inst : Field F] {Idx : Type u} (asg : Idx → F) (i : Idx), Minidregg.Compiler.eval asg (Minidregg.Compiler.vr i) = asg i
∀ {F : Type u} [inst : Field F] {Idx : Type u} {k : ℕ} (asg : Idx → F) (bits : Fin k → Idx), Minidregg.Compiler.eval asg (Minidregg.Compiler.weightedSum bits) = ∑ i, asg (bits i) * 2 ^ ↑i
∀ {F : Type u} [inst : Field F] {k : ℕ}, ∀ n < 2 ^ k, ∃ b, (∀ (i : Fin k), b i = 0 ∨ b i = 1) ∧ ↑n = ∑ i, b i * 2 ^ ↑i

∀ {F : Type u} [inst : Field F] {k : ℕ}, ∀ n < 2 ^ k, ∃ asg, asg Option.none = ↑n ∧ Minidregg.Compiler.systemAccepts asg (Minidregg.Compiler.rangeGadget Option.none fun i => Option.some { down := i })

∀ {F : Type u} [inst : Field F] {Idx : Type u} {k : ℕ} (asg : Idx → F) (xi : Idx) (bits : Fin k → Idx), Minidregg.Compiler.systemAccepts asg (Minidregg.Compiler.rangeGadget xi bits) ↔ (∀ (i : Fin k), asg (bits i) = 0 ∨ asg (bits i) = 1) ∧ asg xi = ∑ i, asg (bits i) * 2 ^ ↑i

∀ {F : Type u} [inst : Field F] {Idx : Type u} {k : ℕ} (asg : Idx → F) (xi : Idx) (bits : Fin k → Idx), Minidregg.Compiler.systemSemHolds asg (Minidregg.Compiler.rangeGadget xi bits) ↔ (∀ (i : Fin k), asg (bits i) = 0 ∨ asg (bits i) = 1) ∧ asg xi = ∑ i, asg (bits i) * 2 ^ ↑i

∀ {k p : ℕ} [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)], 2 ^ k ≤ p → ∀ {Idx : Type} (asg : Idx → ZMod p) (xi : Idx) (bits : Fin k → Idx), Minidregg.Compiler.systemAccepts asg (Minidregg.Compiler.rangeGadget xi bits) → (asg xi).val < 2 ^ k
{F : Type u} → [Field F] → {Idx : Type u} → {k : ℕ} → Idx → (Fin k → Idx) → Minidregg.Compiler.Term (Minidregg.Compiler.AirSig F Idx)

∀ {F : Type u} [inst : Field F] {Idx : Type u} {k : ℕ} (asg : Idx → F) (xi : Idx) (bits : Fin k → Idx), Minidregg.Compiler.accepts asg (Minidregg.Compiler.recompTerm xi bits) ↔ asg xi = ∑ i, asg (bits i) * 2 ^ ↑i
{F : Type u} → [Field F] → {Idx : Type u} → (Idx → F) → Minidregg.Compiler.ConstraintSystem F Idx → Prop := fun {F} [Field F] {Idx} asg sys => ∀ t ∈ sys, Minidregg.Compiler.accepts asg t

∀ {F : Type u} [inst : Field F] {Idx : Type u} (asg : Idx → F) (s₁ s₂ : Minidregg.Compiler.ConstraintSystem F Idx), Minidregg.Compiler.systemAccepts asg (s₁ ++ s₂) ↔ Minidregg.Compiler.systemAccepts asg s₁ ∧ Minidregg.Compiler.systemAccepts asg s₂

∀ {F : Type u} [inst : Field F] {Idx : Type u} {asg : Idx → F} {t : Minidregg.Compiler.Term (Minidregg.Compiler.AirSig F Idx)} {sys : Minidregg.Compiler.ConstraintSystem F Idx}, Minidregg.Compiler.systemAccepts asg (t :: sys) ↔ Minidregg.Compiler.accepts asg t ∧ Minidregg.Compiler.systemAccepts asg sys
∀ {F : Type u} [inst : Field F] {Idx : Type u} (asg : Idx → F) (sys : Minidregg.Compiler.ConstraintSystem F Idx), Minidregg.Compiler.systemAccepts asg sys ↔ Minidregg.Compiler.systemSemHolds asg sys
∀ {F : Type u} [inst : Field F] {Idx : Type u} (asg : Idx → F), Minidregg.Compiler.systemAccepts asg []
{F : Type u} → [Field F] → {Idx : Type u} → (Idx → F) → Minidregg.Compiler.ConstraintSystem F Idx → Prop := fun {F} [Field F] {Idx} asg sys => ∀ t ∈ sys, Minidregg.Compiler.semHolds asg t
{F : Type u} → [Field F] → {Idx : Type u} → {k : ℕ} → (Fin k → Idx) → Minidregg.Compiler.Term (Minidregg.Compiler.AirSig F Idx)

∀ {F : Type u} [inst : Field F] {Idx : Type u} {k : ℕ} (asg : Idx → F) (bits : Fin k → Idx) (l : List (Fin k)), Minidregg.Compiler.eval asg (List.foldr (fun i acc => Minidregg.Compiler.add' (Minidregg.Compiler.mul' (Minidregg.Compiler.vr (bits i)) (Minidregg.Compiler.cst (2 ^ ↑i))) acc) (Minidregg.Compiler.cst 0) l) = (List.map (fun i => asg (bits i) * 2 ^ ↑i) l).sum
